signature.one_line: Micro question-to-answer clip: whip to guest, light lowercase captions beside the speaker.
unique_devices: Complete question -> answer arc in under 15 s: host question in the first ~20 %, a ~10-frame motion-blur whip to the guest, answer immediately
All-lowercase light-weight white captions with no box, placed mid-frame LEFT of centre (line centre x ~39 % W) in the negative space beside the speaker
Single soft ~110 % punch-in on the answer's second sentence as the only other edit (3 shots total)
Dark low-key library set with warm practicals; skin is the brightest element
signature.why_it_works: A universal question is answered within seconds and the quotable line lands at the end, so the clip resolves before attention can drop.

hook.first_frame: Static landscape medium shot of the host at a microphone in a dark library-like set with warm practical lights; lowercase white caption in the empty space beside him at mid-height

structure.what: motion-blur whip from the host to the guest
soft punch-in; the answer is restated and sharpened into a quotable line

captions.what: light lowercase phrase captions beside the speaker
captions.how: 1-4 words (median ~3), one line, no box; line centre x ~39 % W (~44 % on the guest's first shot), centre y 50.5 %, max width 41 % W; Inter 300 81 px on 1920x1080; hard cut ~1 frame after the first word; captions run straight through the whip and stay put through the punch-in

layout.how: 16:9 MS of host (~21 % of runtime) and guest (~79 %); for 9:16 reframe to the speaker and centre the caption

camera.how: one gentle reframe on the answer's second sentence

transitions.what: motion-blur whip from questioner to answerer

captions_spec.script: latin (as spoken; correct mis-transcribed words on screen)

case.caption: all lowercase, including sentence starts and 'I'

captions_spec.punctuation: apostrophes kept; no commas, full stops or question marks

grouping.sync: phrase-level; single long-held words on slow speech

layout.align: centre of the line at x ~39 % W (in the empty space left of the speaker); ~44 % W on a more centred shot

captions_spec.canvas_note: 16:9 landscape. Sizes are given on a 1920x1080 canvas. Mapping onto 1080x1920: (a) recommended - reframed vertical: keep the same px (short-side rule, 81 px on the 1080-wide canvas), centre the line horizontally (x 50 %) at ~50 % height; (b) literal - the 16:9 frame as a full-width band (1080x608, y 656-1264): px x0.5625 (~46 px), x centre 39 %, y centre 50.2 % of 1920.

caption.font_class: light geometric-grotesque sans (Avenir-Next-like: round o, straight-cut t, open spacing), weight ~300-400
caption.calibration_note: measured on the 16:9 frame (words withheld): a 4-word lowercase line with an apostrophe and descender at 6.96 % H / 37.9 % W; a 2-word lowercase line at 5.57 % H / 15.8 % W
caption.shadow: none visible (at most a very faint soft shadow)
caption.font_size_note: px on a 1920x1080 canvas; on 1080x1920 use the same px (short-side rule) - see canvas_note

animation.entry: hard cut, whole phrase in one frame, ~1 frame after the first word
animation.exit: hard cut on the next phrase; captions continue straight through the motion-blur whip
animation.idle: none (captions stay put through the ~110 % punch-in)

caption.closest_local: Inter 300 (Mulish Light / Nunito Sans Light closer)

style.look_intent: dark low-key studio, warm practicals (books, brick, warm curtain), deep blacks, muted natural saturation, low contrast; skin the brightest element

sound.music: voice only (no bed detected); continuous speech
sfx: optional whoosh on the single whip (inferred, not measured; no hard cuts measured)

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

catalog_styles.name: Emphasis-Word Zoom
catalog_styles.role: single soft punch-in on the payoff

use_when: A podcast or interview with a crisp question and a short, quotable answer
Very short (<15 s) clips for teasers or quote posts
Dark, moody studio footage where minimal, light captions keep a premium feel
Landscape source that will run as 16:9 or be reframed with minimal editing
avoid_when: The answer needs more than ~10 s or supporting proof
Bright or busy backgrounds behind the caption space (light-weight white text has no box)
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B17 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B17.json) to this brand.
Native canvas 1920x1080, 30 fps (for 1080x1920: reframe to the speaker, keep the same px, centre the caption at x 50 %, ~50 % H).

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour/font for each role; keep the contrast relationship: light-weight {{TEXT}} needs >= 7:1 on the dark area beside the speaker because it has no box)
- {{TEXT}}: default #FFFFFF
- {{ACCENT}}: none (no emphasis colour)
- {{ACCENT_2}}: none
- {{SURFACE}}: none (footage)
- {{CARD_BG}}: none
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}}: none
- {{FONT_BODY}}: default Inter 300 (Mulish Light / Nunito Sans Light closer)
- {{HANDLE}}: not on screen
- {{LOGO}}: none (optional branded microphones in shot)

CAPTIONS
1. Latin, as spoken, ALL lowercase (including sentence starts and 'i'); apostrophes kept; no other punctuation; no emoji.
2. 1-4 words per phrase (median ~3), one line; hold single words on slow speech.
3. {{FONT_BODY}} at 81 px on 1920x1080, {{TEXT}}, tracking 0, no stroke, no box, at most a very faint soft shadow.
4. 16:9: line centre x ~39 % W (in the empty space beside the speaker; ~44 % on a centred framing), centre y 50.5 %, line top 47 %, max width 41 % W. 9:16 reframe: centred x 50 %, ~50 % H, same px.
5. Hard cut in ~1 frame after the first word, hard cut out on the next phrase; captions continue through the whip and do not move with the punch-in.

EDIT DEVICES
6. Host asks the question in the first ~20 % of runtime; ~10-frame motion-blur whip to the guest; the answer follows immediately.
7. One soft ~110 % punch-in on the answer's second sentence; 3 shots total; end on the quotable line. No titles, lower-thirds, b-roll or end card.

GRADE: Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: dark low-key, warm practicals, deep blacks, muted saturation, skin as the brightest element.
SOUND: voice only, -14 LUFS, true peak <= -1 dBTP (do not let peaks clip).

VERIFY
a) Render "KEY WORD" in lowercase-style light weight at 81 px on 1920x1080 at the caption position and measure:
   python video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test_render> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.18,0.44,0.6,0.58 --ink "{{TEXT}}:70"   (default ink #FFFFFF)
   Expected ink for any phrase from video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py --font "{{FONT_BODY}}" --word "<phrase>" --canvas 1920x1080; a 4-word lowercase line with descenders should be ~7 % H and ~38 % W, a 2-word line ~5.6 % H.
b) Line centre ~39 % W, ~50.5 % H on 16:9.
